rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with `name` front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill move specialized material into linked files. It requires each such link to say when to read the file.

The skill points to two supporting files. Each pointer says when to read the file:
- Workflow step 3 tells the reviewer subagent to read this skill's `references/review-prompt.md`. That is the review step, when subagents check drafted requirements.
- The "Choosing references" section sends the reader to the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md`. It says to read it "to defer a requirement gap the user agrees to", which is when to use `{fixme}`.

The skill also names other documents: the habeas skill's `SKILL.md` and its "Testing and coverage artifacts" section, and the habeas-evidence "Rules" and "Disagreeing assessments" sections. Each is cited with its trigger, so none is an unconditioned link. The skill has no Markdown links to files without a stated condition. It therefore meets the requirement, and I found no gap.
